brief: A calm, practical and approachable personal-finance tracker for people who want a clear monthly view without banking complexity.
criteria: Keep the approved U + treasure icon recognizable at small sizes, preserve its navy/cream/gold geometry, and provide one-colour and reverse uses without implying bank accounts or payment products.

concepts.name: U + Treasure
concepts.idea: The open-entry U sits above a small pile of flat gold coins, pairing the approved letterform with a quiet cue of everyday money.
rationale: The icon preserves the already approved full-bleed navy, cream U, and original gold coin geometry.
Outlined Inter lettering gives the identity a clear app-header lockup without requiring an installed font.
Single-colour and reverse marks provide practical print and dark-surface alternatives.

recommendation: Use the full-colour primary icon for launchers; use the outlined horizontal lockup for product headers and the one-colour reverse where a dark background requires it.
next_steps: Use the relevant platform export from platform/ without changing the approved primary icon.
Complete trademark search and print colour proofing before public brand use.
